# chronofix

[![](reference/figures/hex-chronofix.png)](https://github.com/mrc-ide/chronofix)

# Package index

## Pre-processing

- [`chronofix_prepare_data()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/chronofix/reference/chronofix_prepare_data.md)
  : Prepare data

## MCMC

- [`chronofix_mcmc()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/chronofix/reference/chronofix_mcmc.md)
  : Run MCMC
- [`chronofix_mcmc_control()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/chronofix/reference/chronofix_mcmc_control.md)
  : Create control parameters
- [`chronofix_mcmc_initial()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/chronofix/reference/chronofix_mcmc_initial.md)
  : Create initial parameter values
- [`chronofix_hyperparameters()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/chronofix/reference/chronofix_hyperparameters.md)
  : Create hyperparameters

## Post-processing

### Plotting functions

- [`chronofix_plot_delays()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/chronofix/reference/chronofix_plot_delays.md)
  : Plot Estimated Delay Distributions

### Summarise functions

- [`chronofix_linelist()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/chronofix/reference/chronofix_linelist.md)
  : Generate and export highlighted reconstructed linelist
- [`chronofix_summarise_delays()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/chronofix/reference/chronofix_summarise_delays.md)
  : Get Summary Table of Estimated Delays

## Simulate data

- [`chronofix_simulate_data()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/chronofix/reference/chronofix_simulate_data.md)
  : Simulate a dataset with true dates, observed dates and error
  indicators
- [`chronofix_simulate_observation_errors()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/chronofix/reference/chronofix_simulate_observation_errors.md)
  : Add observation errors
- [`chronofix_simulate_true_data()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/chronofix/reference/chronofix_simulate_true_data.md)
  : Simulate true data
